analyzed_vuln.description: ReflectionEnumBackedCase::getBackingValue() calls zend_enum_fetch_case_value(Z_OBJ(ref->value)) without validating that ref->value is actually an enum case object with the expected property layout. The function only updates constants if IS_CONSTANT_AST, then relies on assertions (intern->ce->enum_backing_type and zend_enum_fetch_case_value asserts) for type safety. In non-assert builds, a malformed/non-enum object in ref->value leads OBJ_PROP_NUM(zobj,1) to read past the allocated object, causing the heap-buffer-overflow seen in zend_enum_fetch_case_value.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires constructing a ReflectionEnumBackedCase for a backed enum case whose stored class-constant value becomes an unexpected object state (via malformed enum backing expression from attacker-controlled PHP source in the fuzzer input). Data flow: fuzzed PHP script defines enum/case -> ReflectionEnumBackedCase object is created -> getBackingValue() fetches ref->value and passes its object pointer to zend_enum_fetch_case_value without runtime type/shape checks -> out-of-bounds read of property slot 1 when object is not a valid enum case instance.
